reasoningChain.evidence: Entering Chapter 2 with stronger direct damage supports continued progression.
The ranger solved the prior sustained-damage wall and remains a verified active physical contributor.
The boss weapon is legendary, grants twice the physical power of the ranger's current common weapon, and adds execution, critical, might, poison, and low-health damage.
Upgrading the verified active ranger preserves the proven roster; equipping the untested assassin would not contribute until a separate risky swap.
